[EN] What is the meaning of this?
[ES] ¿Qué significa esto?

[EN] Ha! Finally, some good news!
[ES] ¡Ja! ¡Por fin, buenas noticias!

[EN] You know as well as I do they don't have motives. For now, our top priority is to secure the the recovered territory.
[ES] Tú sabes tan bien como yo que no tienen motivaciones. Por ahora, nuestra máxima prioridad es asegurar el territorio recuperado.
